about: Lindsey Graham was a Republican who served as U.S. Senator from South Carolina from January 3, 2003, until his death on July 11, 2026, after serving in the U.S. House from 1995 to 2003. He was born in Central, Pickens County, South Carolina, on July 9, 1955.
